# Third-party licences

Licence texts for vendor material that FrameForge's bindings and data are derived from. See `docs/frameforge/references.md` for what each covers.

| File | Covers |
|---|---|
| `NVAPI-License.txt` | NVIDIA NVAPI SDK (MIT). Source of `ffi/nvapi_types.rs` and `nvidia/driver_settings.rs`. |
| `IGCL-License.txt` | Intel Graphics Control Library (Intel Software License Agreement: use and redistribution solely for use on Intel platforms). Source of `ffi/igcl_types.rs`. |
| `PresentMon-License.txt` | Intel PresentMon (MIT). Source of `ffi/presentmon_types.rs`. |

NVIDIA Profile Inspector's licence (MIT) is next to the file it covers: `crates/core/src/frameforge/nvidia/data/LICENSE-nvidiaProfileInspector.txt`.

AMD ADLX is not listed because nothing derived from it is in this repository.
